text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Sapporo Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru spots a decorative lilac tree in the waiting room, and is overjoyed at finding a supposed good-luck omen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After saying her prayers to the great gods of the north, she leaves for the track.
